description: Up to 94 wind turbine generators will be installed within 102 potential positions
context_quote: The proposed Project would allow Sunrise Wind to construct, operate, maintain, and eventually decommission a wind energy facility with an operating capacity ranging between 924 megawatts (MW) and 1,034 MW in scale. The Project would include up to 94 wind turbine generators (WTGs) at 102 potential locations, one Offshore Converter Station (OCS-DC), offshore export cable routes, onshore cable landfall sites, onshore cable routes, and onshore substation locations.

description: Wind turbine generators will have a maximum upper blade tip height of 787 feet (240 meters) above mean sea level
context_quote: The WTGs would be sited in a uniform east-west/north-south grid with 1.15 by 1.15-mile (mi) (1 by 1-nautical mile [nm]; 1.85 by 1.85 kilometer [km]) spacing. Sunrise Wind would maintain diagonal lanes between 0.7 and 0.9 mi (0.6 to 0.8 nm; 1.1 and 1.5 km) wide when micrositing foundations. Sunrise Wind would mount the WTGs on monopile foundations. The WTG foundations as proposed in the COP would be 39 ft (12 m) in diameter at the seabed and 23 ft (7 m) in diameter at the sea surface (Sunrise Wind 2022). The upper blade tip height of the WTGs would be 787 ft (240 m) above mean sea level (AMSL).

description: The offshore converter station (OCS-DC) will be placed on a four-legged piled jacket foundation
context_quote: The OCS-DC would be placed on an up to four-legged piled jacket foundation. A piled jacket foundation is formed of a steel lattice construction (comprising tubular steel members and welded joints) secured to the seafloor by means of hollow steel pin piles attached to the jacket.

description: The offshore export cable (SRWEC) will consist of one 320-kilovolt (kV) DC cable bundle buried to a target depth of 3 to 7 feet (1 to 2 meters)
context_quote: The SRWEC would be located in federal and New York state waters and would be one 320-kilovolt (kV) DC export cable bundle buried to a target depth of 3 to 7 feet (ft) (1 to 2 meters [m]).

description: The onshore transmission cable will be buried underground for up to 339 feet (4,080 meters)
context_quote: The onshore portion of the SRWEC, up to 339 ft (4,080 m) would be buried underground.

description: A temporary pile-supported pier will be constructed on the inshore side of Fire Island, extending approximately 240 feet (73 meters) offshore and 16 feet (4.9 meters) wide
geographic_scope: Temporary pier location on Fire Island
context_quote: To allow for the transportation of equipment and materials from Long Island to the construction site on Fire Island, a temporary pile-supported pier would be constructed on the inshore side of Fire Island. The pier would extend approximately 240 feet (73 m) offshore and be approximately 16-feet (4.9-m) wide.

description: The temporary pier will use up to 24 production piles and up to 24 temporary piles, either 14 x 14-inch (36.5 x 36.5 cm) H-shaped or 16-inch (40.6-cm) diameter round steel piles
geographic_scope: Temporary pier location on Fire Island
context_quote: The precise pier design and type of piles have not yet been determined, but it is anticipated that up to 24 production piles would be used. Production piles would be either a 14 x 14-inch (36.5 x 36.5 cm) H-shaped pile or a 16-inch (40.6-cm) diameter round steel pile. In addition, up to 24 temporary piles (of the same size as the production piles) may be used to support the installation of the production piles and may be installed and removed during construction activities.

description: Up to two horizontal directional drill (HDD) cables will be installed at the landfall site, each with a maximum length of 0.9 miles (1.5 kilometers) and a diameter of 3 feet (0.9 meters)
geographic_scope: Landfall site at Smith Point County Park
context_quote: There would be a total of 6 HDD cable ducts with a target burial depth of 5 to 75 ft (1.5 to 25 m). The ducts would have a maximum length of 0.9 mi (1.5 km) and a diameter of 3 ft (0.9 m).

description: Up to six goal posts made of two vertical sheet piles and a horizontal cross beam may be installed to support the HDD casing pipes
geographic_scope: Landfall site at Smith Point County Park
context_quote: Up to six goal posts may be installed to support installation of the casing pipe. Each goal post would be composed of two vertical sheet piles and a horizontal cross beam.

description: Up to 20 additional support sheet piles may be installed to help anchor the barge and support HDD construction activities
geographic_scope: Landfall site at Smith Point County Park
context_quote: In addition to the goal posts, up to 20 additional support sheet piles 100 feet (30 m) long, 2 feet (0.6 m) wide, and 1 inch thick may be installed to help anchor the barge and support construction activities.

description: A maximum of 33 vessels would be operating simultaneously during cable installation activities
geographic_scope: Sunrise Wind Farm (SRWF) and export cable routes
context_quote: During installation of array and SRWEC cable, Sunrise Wind anticipates a maximum of 33 vessels required for IAC installation and 38 vessels for the installation of the SRWEC.

description: A maximum of 13 wind turbine vessels would be deployed simultaneously during WTG foundation installation
context_quote: During installation of the 94 WTG and the OCS-DC and associated foundations, 13 wind turbine vessels would be deployed simultaneously during foundation installation and 6 wind turbine vessels would be deployed simultaneously during structure installation.

description: A maximum of 6 wind turbine vessels would be deployed simultaneously during WTG structure installation
context_quote: During installation of the 94 WTG and the OCS-DC and associated foundations, 13 wind turbine vessels would be deployed simultaneously during foundation installation and 6 wind turbine vessels would be deployed simultaneously during structure installation.

description: A maximum of 15 vessels would be used for OCS-DC installation
context_quote: It is anticipated that 15 vessels would be required for OCS-DC installation.

description: Pile driving for WTG monopile foundations will use a maximum hammer energy of 4,000 kilojoules
context_quote: Monopile foundations for WTGs will be up to 7/12 m in diameter and installed using an impact pile driver with a maximum hammer energy of up to 4,000 kilojoules (kJ).

description: The OCS-DC jacket foundation will use pin piles up to 13 feet (4 meters) in diameter, installed using a maximum 4,000 kilojoule hammer
context_quote: The pin piles used to secure the OCS–DC piled jacket foundation will be up to 13 ft (4 m) in diameter and installed using an impact pile driver with a maximum hammer energy of up to 4,000 kJ.
